description: This file defines structures, functions, and enums related to shadow geometry and vertex generation for OpenGL rendering in Android's graphics engine, ported from Skia. It includes shadow geometry creation, vertex and index filling, and shadow texture data functions.
external_methods: std::lib math functions (e.g., std::sin, std::cos, etc.)

classes.name: Geometry
classes.description: Represents shadow geometry data including color, radii, bounds, type, and flags for circle and stroke.

methods.name: getSpotShadowGeometry
methods.description: Creates shadow geometry for a spotlight source based on caster rectangle, corner radius, Z position, translucency, color, light position, and radius.

methods.name: getAmbientShadowGeometry
methods.description: Creates ambient shadow geometry based on caster rectangle, corner radius, Z position, translucency, and color.

methods.name: getVertexCountForGeometry
methods.description: Returns the number of vertices needed for a given shadow geometry.

methods.name: getIndexCountForGeometry
methods.description: Returns the number of indices needed for a given shadow geometry.

methods.name: fillVerticesForGeometry
methods.description: Fills vertex arrays with position, color, and parameters for the shadow geometry.

methods.name: fillIndicesForGeometry
methods.description: Fills index array for the shadow geometry starting from a specified vertex offset.

methods.name: fillShadowTextureData
methods.description: Fills a texture data array with shadow falloff data for quick lookup in shaders.

calls: std::lib math functions (e.g., std::sin, std::cos, etc.)
